title: Principles of Ethereum
description:
Ethereum has no single authority to instruct it. It is continually shaped by what its community chooses to build, fund, defend, and decline - long before any formal governance process begins. This five-minute talk presents the proposed Ethereum Principles as a cultural substrate for those decisions: common ground that helps a diverse ecosystem remain coherent without becoming centrally controlled.

More here - for anyone to comment: https://docs.fileverse.io/u/0/w/personal/document/8DpWf3qM7SLJYR6LB15PKo#k=N44z0ynYPiVRJOcdIlmkAT2dvAbqehTh6RJ6Tog_ZZM
